selection_evidence: The COMMAND reference build invokes MASM with -Icmd and -Iinc, but not -Idos, and no cmd/parse.asm is present.
inc/parse.asm defines SysParse; dos/parse.asm implements DOS file-descriptor parsing rather than SysParse.
Reference tparse listing defines SysParse, Cmd_parse and Append_parse in the same TRANCODE segment.
limitations: The target parser body differs in length from the provisional reference; the body and relocation are not verified.
The source dependency is established for the historical build, not proof that the final DOS 7 build uses identical source.
